items.q: They don't care if it's Paul Whiteman.

ctx.x: Oh, Fatha, Fatha Hines. Yeah. Well, they don't care who it is. They don't care if it's Paul Whiteman. They're going to talk at that bar and everything, and the people that listen to you are over across from the bar. They're over here. Now, you're in the middle, so all you do is just stand up there and just play what you're playing, that's all. And every now and then point your horn over there to the tables. Because these people around here, they're talking about the baseball game and about the football game.
